title: First Mid Helps Continue Paint-A-Thon Tradition in Southeast Iowa
summary: Burlington, IA (June 30, 2026) First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid), Community Action of Southeast Iowa, and Sherwin-Williams are partnering to continue a longstanding Southeast Iowa tradition through the 33rd annual Paint-A-Thon, which will kick off on September 7 following Labor Day weekend. For more than three decades, the Paint-A-Thon has helped qualifying homeowners improve and maintain their homes through volunteer-led painting projects, strengthening neighborhoods throughout Burlington, West Burlington, Mediapolis, and surrounding communities. Over the past 32 years, volunteers have painted more than 573 homes and contributed countless hours of service to homeowners throughout Southeast Iowa. The program helps homeowners preserve the appearance and value of their properties while fostering community pride and volunteerism. Paint-A-Thon has made a lasting impact in Southeast Iowa for more than 30 years, and we're proud to help carry on that tradition, said Shane
